detailed_description: This scheme provide grant to farmers on tube well mining and pump installation. The main objective of the scheme is to increase the productivity and crop intensity by making proper use of available ground water through tube wells and providing irrigation facilities to the crops.
eligibility:
1. Farmers of all categories of districts will be benefited.
1. Preference will be given to small and marginal farmers
1. The farmers who have received the benefit of tube well mining grant in the past under any other scheme run by the department or under this scheme will not be eligible.
